name: Warden
text: Decision: We should run a full network scan with a tool like Nmap to map every live device and open port on our perimeter. This gives us a real-time picture of what’s actually exposed, not what we *think* is exposed. The trade-off is that the scan will generate traffic and might trigger alerts in monitoring systems, but the visibility gain outweighs the temporary noise. Without this, we’re flying blind—assuming our firewall rules match reality.
